kaue01.title: Table for one, and loving it
kaue01.caption:
The host said "just one?" like it was a problem. Aries heard "the whole booth is yours."
Dessert first, obviously. Who else orders like this?

kaue02.title: Slept diagonal, woke up thriving
kaue02.caption: Four pillows, zero blanket thieves, one Taurus sleeping corner to corner. Tell us your sign sleeps diagonal too.

kaue03.title: Went to the concert solo
kaue03.caption: Gemini turned to say "did you SEE that" and remembered they came alone. So they sang both parts of the duet instead. Have you ever gone to a show solo?

kaue04.title: Cooked for one, made enough for twelve
kaue04.caption: Cancer tried to cook for one person and accidentally fed every day of the next two weeks. Labelled, of course. Who in your life cooks like this?

kaue05.title: Bought myself the flowers
kaue05.caption: To: Leo. From: Leo. With love. The photo shoot that followed was not optional. When did you last buy yourself something nice?

kaue06.title: A Friday night with a 1,000-piece puzzle
kaue06.caption: 999 pieces down, one missing, full panic. Virgo found it in the last place anyone would look: under Virgo. What's your favourite quiet Friday?
